title: heuchera parvifolia var. utahensis
intro: Heuchera parvifolia var. utahensis, commonly known as Utah alumroot, is a perennial plant species native to the southwestern United States. It is used as a medicinal herb, valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions attributed to Utah alumroot include wound healing, skin protection, and the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
